description: Fast country-scoped, language-specific city name prefix search backed by pre-built static files. Works without a Geomelon API key. Returns up to 10 cities sorted by population, with the requested language name and an English fallback.

language.description: BCP 47 language code to search against (e.g. "es", "ja")

prefix.description: City name prefix as typed by the user

name: search_cities_autocomplete
